after.name: RegisterFloat3FieldOffset
after.signature: void * PS4_SYSV RegisterFloat3FieldOffset(void * registry, char * property_name, uint object_offset)

evidence: Complete514 original instruction spans match executable bytes.
Generic native inputs are RDI registry, RSI property name and EDX offset; fixed NodeCustomIcon takes RDI registry and ESI offset.
Original float3, ESoundCategory, NodeCustomIcon and ENodeCustomIcon literals checked.
Cold backup, isolated trial, promotion and independent reopening verify exactly four name/signature entries changed.
Connected Microchip caller decompiles with correct descriptor/labels/offsets and no phantom incomingRCX.
caveats: Observed RAX working pointer outputs do not recover original C++ return declarations.
Descriptor numeric tags are not asserted as byte widths.
Reserve/hash/type/guard implementations and full registration/game lifecycle not executed in this review.
